title: The True Face of the Heavenly Eye
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was about to press further, the voice suddenly shattered into fragments, as if some force was tearing apart its will—behind this puppet, who exactly is pulling the strings?

text.content: The golden vertical pupil dilated without any warning, as if the heavens themselves had been torn open. Chen Ji felt the spiritual energy around him suddenly freeze, the oppressive force far surpassing anything before—not a mere accumulation of power, but a qualitative leap, as if he were no longer facing a projection of will, but some existence beyond imagination.

His spine involuntarily tensed, fingertips trembling slightly—this was the body's instinctive reaction to danger, unrelated to willpower. The Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace burned like a branding iron, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul surging violently: "Something's wrong... its form is too complete! This isn't a projection, this is..." The words cut off abruptly, as if some force had sealed his mouth.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji." The voice was no longer a condescending审视, but carried a certain weariness and mechanical sensation. "Do you think laying out schemes across the world means you hold victory in your hands? Do you think seeing three hours ahead means you've pierced through heavenly secrets?" Deep within the vertical pupil, light swirled, yet no longer pure. "You are merely struggling自以为 on a much larger chessboard.

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He noticed the anomaly in that voice—weariness? Mechanical sensation? The Heavenly Eye had been a supreme existence towering above all since his earliest memories, never had it possessed such an... emptied quality? He forcefully suppressed the churning in his heart, his mind racing. Mo Xiansheng silenced, the Tianji Record abnormally scalding—everything pointed toward a possibility he dared not contemplate deeply.

The vertical pupil continued dilating, and within the golden light, densely packed patterns began to emerge—those patterns ancient and eerie, each containing an intoxicating aura of the Dao. Yet just as Chen Ji gazed intently, his heart lurched: between those patterns, countless tiny cracks existed, like the joints of a repeatedly used puppet.

dialogue.content: (Speaking slowly, his voice平静得近乎嘲讽) A puppet is ultimately just a puppet. Even if draped in the guise of heaven's way, it cannot conceal those... traces of use on you." His gaze was like a blade. "Who wore you down like this? How long? How many times?

text.content: The vertical pupil's light hesitated for an instant. That momentary stillness was extremely brief, brief enough that ordinary people could not detect it, but Chen Ji caught it. He stared fixedly at that crack, a string in his mind suddenly tensing—was the Heavenly Eye hesitating? Fearing? It was an existence above all living beings—what could make it hesitate? The answer hovered on the verge of surfacing: the master behind it.

The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly shuddered violently, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul's voice squeezing out with difficulty: "It... isn't heaven's way... it's..." Before the words finished, the fragment dimmed abruptly, as if forcibly suppressed by some power. Chen Ji was greatly shaken—even the fragment's guardian could not speak the truth? How terrifying, then, was the existence behind the Heavenly Eye?

He drew a deep breath, fingertips unconsciously rubbing the edge of the Tianji Record. Three thousand years of scheming, countless predictions and alterations, he had believed he fully understood the Heavenly Eye's operating patterns. Yet only now did he realize—those so-called "patterns" were merely mechanical reactions when the puppet executed its master's commands. The true game was far beyond his sight.

choice.prompt: Facing this truth transcending cognition, Chen Ji must make a choice—whether to continue digging into the secrets behind the puppet, or temporarily lie low to gather more intelligence?

choices.description: Directly expose the puppet's essence, interrogate the identity of the mastermind behind it
choices.visible_cost: May trigger the hostility of an unknown existence
choices.visible_reward: May obtain key fragments of truth
choices.risk_hint: If the mastermind is alerted, consequences are unpredictable

dialogue.content: (Stepping forward, his gaze like a sword stabbing into the depths of the vertical pupil) You are merely a worn-out tool. Who is the real chess player? Speak!" His voice was not loud, yet carried undeniable oppression. "Every generation of prophets has been your pawn, and I am merely one of them—the face of that chess player, surely you must have seen it?

choices.description: Avoid direct confrontation, retreat to advance, seek flaws from details
choices.visible_cost: May miss the opportunity for direct questioning
choices.visible_reward: A more steady method to obtain the truth

dialogue.content: (Retreating half a step, his expression反而平静下来) Interesting. The noble Heavenly Eye actually shows fatigue." A faint smile crossed his face. "Let me guess—you've been questioned like this before, haven't you? Among the prophets throughout history, has anyone gone further than me? What became of them?

choices.text: Using the Tianji Record as Bait
choices.description: With the power of the Tianji Record Fragment, actively stimulate a connection with the puppet
choices.visible_cost: Consumes a large amount of Heavenly Fate
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate consumption may endanger life

dialogue.content: (Slowly raising the Tianji Record Fragment, a resolute light flickering in his eyes) You can seal Mo Xiansheng's mouth, but can you seal my eyes?" The fragment suddenly bloomed with light. "Since you are a puppet, let me see—what kind of craftsmanship did the maker who created you possess!

text.content: The vertical pupil contracted violently, and the cracks within those golden patterns actually expanded slightly under Chen Ji's gaze. He saw a blurry image—an endless darkness, something gazing at him, its gaze ice-cold and mechanical, utterly devoid of emotion.

dialogue.content: What... did you see?" The Heavenly Eye's voice trembled for the first time, no longer mechanically cold, but something close to instinctive wariness. "No... you cannot possibly see... that One..." The golden light in the vertical pupil began to chaotic, like a puppet whose strings had gone out of control.

text.content: A great wave crashed in Chen Ji's heart—"that One"? Even the Heavenly Eye used a respectful title for that existence? He stared fixedly at those cracks, his mind racing through possibilities. The Tianji Record was its piece placed in the mortal world—what about itself? Was it also merely a piece on an even larger chessboard? Were the tragedies of all past prophets all derived from the schemes of this mastermind?

He suddenly laughed, that smile carrying a hint of madness. Three thousand years of scheming, calculating all heroes under heaven, believing he had touched the edge of the chessboard—yet he had not even seen the material of the board. This frustration would be enough to break an ordinary person, but Chen Ji was different—the fire burning in his eyes was not fear, but an even fiercer fighting spirit.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji has glimpsed the shadow behind the puppet—what should he do next?

choices.description: Press the weakening puppet relentlessly, forcing out more truth
choices.visible_cost: The puppet may completely lose control
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more information about the mastermind
choices.risk_hint: The risk of backlash from the unknown existence is extremely high

dialogue.content: (Stepping forward, momentum soaring) Since the floodgates are open, don't think you can close them again! Speak—what is that "existence"? What does it want? Why create a puppet like you?" His voice cut like a blade. "Or perhaps... you don't know? Because you are merely a preset tool, not even qualified to question your master?

choices.description: Outwardly comply, actually record all details in secret, seek flaws
choices.risk_hint: May miss the golden opportunity to uncover the truth

dialogue.content: (His expression restrained, stepping back, recovering that harmless appearance) Forget it, I was merely asking casually." He said nonchalantly. "Since you won't speak, I won't ask. However..." His gaze was profound. "I hope the next time we meet, you can give me a satisfactory answer.

text.content: The golden light in the vertical pupil suddenly froze, then began vibrating at some eerie frequency. Chen Ji keenly sensed that was not anger, but something deeper—仿佛 the Heavenly Eye was engaging in some silent communication with its master. The cracks expanded several times over in that instant, and within the golden light, a wisp of black qi actually seeped through.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji..." The Heavenly Eye's voice became fragmented, mixed with mechanical static. "You shouldn't... have seen... this... this is... a warning... also..." Suddenly, its voice rose sharply, filled with some inhuman terror. "No! I don't want to... I don't want to... again...!" The vertical pupil suddenly contracted into a single point.

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He saw it—within that final light, at the core of the Heavenly Eye, there赫然 existed a blurry human silhouette. That silhouette was screaming, mouth wide open yet producing no sound, as if enduring endless torment. The fate of all past prophets had, at this moment, its most cruel footnote.

So that's how it is." Chen Ji's voice was very soft, yet carried a bone-deep chill. "You are not some materialized embodiment of heavenly will, you are... a prison." He stared at that struggling figure. "Countless prophets' consciousnesses are imprisoned within, serving as fuel to maintain your operation. And the true mastermind..." His gaze pierced through the golden light, gazing into the endless darkness beyond. "Lies hidden in the place you dare not even look at.

choice.prompt: The truth has emerged—Chen Ji must make a final decision: confront the abyss, or first seek self-preservation?

choices.description: Directly challenge the mastermind, declare his independent will
choices.visible_cost: Completely exposed before the unknown existence
choices.visible_reward: May break free from the manipulated fate

dialogue.content: (Lifting his head abruptly, his gaze like a sword stabbing into the depths of darkness) I know you are watching! You created this puppet, enslaved countless souls, schemed for ten thousand years—yet never calculated that Chen Ji would stand here!" His voice echoed in the void. "Want to continue using me as a chess piece? Fine, first ask if my hands agree!

choices.description: Deeply bury what was witnessed today, secretly seek methods to deal with the mastermind
choices.risk_hint: May be noticed by the mastermind

dialogue.content: (Restraining his momentum, withdrawing his gaze from the darkness) What happened today, I have recorded." He said calmly. "Since you hide so deeply, I presume you're in no hurry for this moment." A cold smile curved his lips. "We... will meet again.

text.content: Just as Chen Ji's words fell, from the depths of that darkness came a faint, barely audible laughter. That laughter carried no emotion, ice-cold and mechanical, like the sound of gears meshing. The vertical pupil suddenly shattered, dissolving into countless golden specks scattered across the void, leaving only that laughter echoing in Chen Ji's ears—mocking, warning, and some profound invitation.

Chen Ji stood quietly in place, his spiritual energy already chaotic, the script on the Tianji Record Fragment even dimmer than before. He looked down at his hands—the slight trembling was not fear, but some extreme rage held in check. Three thousand years of chess games, originally just others' leftover tricks; believing himself meticulous in planning, yet never even glimpsed the opponent's true face.

But he did not despair. Quite the opposite, at this moment his heart was clearer than ever. Since it is a chess game, there must be a way to break the board; since there is a manipulator, there must be means to deal with the manipulator. The Heavenly Eye's collapse was not an ending, but a beginning—a new, even larger chess game was slowly unfolding before him.

Mo Xiansheng's voice finally sounded again, carrying the relief of surviving a disaster and deep worry: "Master... what you witnessed just now, be sure not to mention it to anyone. That One's existence..." He paused. "Even this old one has only glimpsed a fraction. But one thing is certain—the complete version of the Tianji Record may hold the key to opposing it." The script on the fragment flickered slightly, as if witnessing the weight of these words.

Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze piercing through layers of void, as if about to lock eyes with that existence in the heavens. A smile slowly curved his lips, containing madness, determination, and the excitement of a great curtain about to rise. "Very well." He murmured. "Since you want to play a bigger game, I shall accompany you to the end." The Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace let out a soft sound, as if responding, as if resonating. The chaotic chess game had truly begun.
